plugins.cameraPermission: Circle Up needs camera access to verify your identity with a live selfie during signup.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Circle Up needs your location to verify you live in the neighbourhood you're joining, to attach a location to an SOS alert, and to share your live location with trusted contacts while the app is open.

plugins.photosPermission: Circle Up needs photo access as a fallback if camera access isn't available.

plugins.microphonePermission: Circle Up needs microphone access to send voice notes in chats, and — only if you turn on Silent Phrase in Circle Guard settings — to listen for your chosen safety phrase while the app is open in the foreground.
